text: A few weeks after go-live, Hannah Reyes and Tobias Lindgren each bring Devon Okafor the exact same complaint, separately.
Their Warranty Claims by Region report shows almost no open claims for their own team -- even though their reps are filing real ones every day.
Devon checks the obvious first: the Private org-wide default and the Warranty_Claim_Manager_Visibility sharing rule are both correctly built. Neither is the problem.
The real cause is in the Role Hierarchy itself: Hannah and Tobias sit beside their own reps, not above them.
Next: fixing the hierarchy at the root, not patching around it.
